Package com.threadpool

package com.threadpool
  • Classes
    Class
    Description
    App
    Just initializes the thread pool and assigns arbitrary tasks to it.
    Task
    Task class represents a unit of work that can be executed by a worker thread.
    ThreadPool
    ThreadPool ThreadPool class manages a pool of worker threads that execute tasks from a shared task queue.
    ThreadSafeTaskQueue
    ThreadSafeTaskQueue ThreadSafeTaskQueue class provides a thread-safe implementation of a task queue that allows multiple threads to submit and retrieve tasks concurrently.
    Worker
    Worker class represents a worker thread that continuously fetches and executes tasks from a shared task queue.
